title: RSI overbought/oversold + special doji entry with martingale recovery
entry_long: candle ID1 special doji: lower_wick>upper_wick and lower_wick/2>upper_wick and lower_wick>body_size, and RSI14<30 (oversold) -> buy fix 0.1L, no SL/TP
entry_short: candle ID1 special doji: upper_wick>lower_wick and upper_wick/2>lower_wick and upper_wick>body_size, and RSI14>70 (overbought) -> sell fix 0.1L, no SL/TP
exit: close basket per side (buy or sell) when unrealized profit > $50; no SL/TP per order
escalation_cap: none stated - no max order count, lot doubles via RSI-zone rule (2x if RSI 0-30 at recovery, else fixed 0.1)
buildon_idea: add explicit max recovery-order cap or hard lot ceiling; test flat-lot (no martingale) version first to confirm entry-only edge
novelty_note: RSI extreme + doji reversal filter is common; recovery ladder scaled by RSI zone (small vs large lot step chosen by RSI band) is a mild novelty

title: 3-candle high/low breakout with fixed SL/TP, no recovery layer
entry_long: price crosses above Upper_Line (highest high of candle ID1-ID3) -> buy fix 0.1L, SL 100 pips, TP 200 pips
entry_short: price crosses below Lower_Line (lowest low of candle ID1-ID3) -> sell fix 0.1L, SL 100 pips, TP 200 pips
exit: SL 100 pips / TP 200 pips only; no martingale or grid recovery in this base version
buildon_idea: author explicitly invites adding martingale/custom-sequence recovery for losers; add a position cap + linear-add lot law if extending, since smaller TF multiplies order count fast
novelty_note: simple 3-candle range breakout with fixed SL/TP; low novelty, framed by author as an order-volume ('ปั่นล็อต') generator baseline

title: Monthly profit-target auto-stop wrapper on ICT-zone engulfing entry (builds on ex.19)
entry_long: 3 consecutive bearish candles ID1-ID3 with combined body>=50pips define ICT_Zone_B1/B2; when price sits between them and closes above ID1 open (engulf) -> buy fix lot, no SL/TP; gated by monthly start_mode=1
entry_short: mirror: 3 consecutive bullish candles define ICT_Zone_S1/S2; price closes below ID1 open (engulf down) -> sell fix lot, no SL/TP; same monthly gating
exit: close basket both sides when unrealized profit > target_profit ($100); then start_mode reset to 0, EA pauses until next calendar month re-enables it via 12 month_filter blocks
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed lot); risk capped instead by a $100 monthly profit-lock that halts trading for remainder of the month
buildon_idea: the reusable module here is the monthly profit-lock wrapper (12x month_filter blocks + counter + start_mode flag) - can bolt onto any EA to cap monthly gain/exposure; combine with a capped martingale entry layer for more orders
novelty_note: monthly auto-stop-after-target wrapper is a genuinely reusable risk-control technique; underlying ICT engulfing entry itself is standard and references EX019

title: Single-candle pattern entry, balance-scaled starting lot, toggleable martingale recovery (RV1)
entry_long: ID1 candle matches either (bearish, lower_wick>=40% of candle_size) or (bullish, both wicks<=20%), candle_size>=100pips -> buy, lot = account_balance/100000
entry_short: mirror: ID1 (bullish, upper_wick>=40%) or (bearish, both wicks<=20%), candle_size>=100pips -> sell, lot = balance/100000
exit: close basket both sides when unrealized profit > $10; no SL/TP per order
escalation_cap: none stated - no max order count; only an optional account-level cut_loss at 30% of balance, disabled by default
buildon_idea: add an explicit max recovery-order cap; enable the 30%-balance cut_loss by default instead of leaving it off; test flat-lot version (L_Plus_Mode=false) to isolate entry edge
novelty_note: balance-scaled starting lot (lot = balance/100000) plus a selectable martingale-vs-fixed recovery toggle and an optional 30%-balance circuit breaker; moderate novelty in the toggle design

title: Single-candle pattern entry with linear lot-add recovery, capped at 30 orders per side (RV4)
entry_long: ID1 candle matches either (bearish, lower_wick>=30% of candle_size, candle_size>=100pips) or (bullish, both wicks<=20%) -> buy fix 0.1L
entry_short: mirror: ID1 (bullish, upper_wick>=30%) or (bearish, both wicks<=20%) -> sell fix 0.1L
exit: close basket both sides when unrealized profit > $30
escalation_cap: Max_Order = 30 per side (buy capped 30 orders, sell capped 30 orders); recovery grid distance fixed at 50 pips, lot +0.02 per step when L_Plus_Mode on (else fixed 0.1)
buildon_idea: already capped at 30 orders/side; run flat-lot test to confirm entry-only edge; consider tightening the cap or adding a per-order SL before any live use
novelty_note: explicit per-side order cap (30) on an intentional lot-generation ('ปั่นล็อต') EA is a notable risk control, more disciplined than other EAs in this series

title: RSI overbought/oversold + special doji entry with rebalance (reverse-direction) recovery
entry_long: candle ID1 special doji (lower_wick>upper_wick, lower_wick/2>upper_wick, lower_wick>body) and RSI14<30 -> buy fix 0.01L
entry_short: candle ID1 special doji (upper_wick>lower_wick, upper_wick/2>lower_wick, upper_wick>body) and RSI14>70 -> sell fix 0.01L
exit: close basket both sides when unrealized profit > $10
escalation_cap: none stated - no max order count on either the same-direction add-on orders or the opposite-direction rebalance orders; grid distance 50 pips
buildon_idea: add an explicit max order cap per side; the rebalance mechanism (open an opposite-direction order after an adverse move instead of doubling same direction) is a distinct, reusable recovery idea worth combining with a hard cap + SL
novelty_note: rebalance recovery -- opening the opposite-direction order on reversal at an RSI-extreme entry, rather than plain same-direction martingale -- is a distinct mechanism worth cataloging separately

title: Dynamic grid-zone range trading with lot step-up and TP relocation at order-count threshold
indicators: dynamic price zone: entry-time price +/- 1500 pips as Upper/Lower bound lines
entry_long: price within [Lower_Line, Upper_Line] zone set at EA init/reset (entry_price +/-1500pips) -> buy 0.01L on a 100-pip grid inside the zone, TP 20 pips, no SL
entry_short: mirror: sell 0.01L on the same 100-pip grid inside the zone, TP 20 pips, no SL
exit: close basket both sides when profit > $5; additionally when buy (or sell) order count >=10, all same-side TPs are relocated to first order's open price +20 pips and lot grows +0.01 per further bar; zone lines re-center after every basket close
escalation_cap: no explicit max order cap stated; the TP-relocation-at-10-orders mechanism softens exposure but lot size keeps growing thereafter; optional -$3000 cut_loss toggle, off by default
buildon_idea: add an explicit hard order cap; enable the -$3000 cut_loss by default rather than leaving it off; the dynamic re-centering zone plus Modify_Stop TP-relocation-to-breakeven-plus-X technique is a reusable exit module worth extracting for other range-grid EAs
novelty_note: relocating TP for all open grid orders to a single breakeven+20pip reference once order count crosses a threshold is a distinct, reusable exit technique -- moderate novelty

title: LINE Notify push-notification integration wrapper
entry_long: n/a - demo EA opens a trivial fixed-volume buy every bar (0.1L, SL 2 pips, TP 2 pips) purely to trigger the notification demo
entry_short: n/a - mirrors trivial sell demo, same SL/TP
exit: SL/TP 2 pips (demo only, not a real strategy)
buildon_idea: reusable LINE Notify token+API block for push alerts (EA start, order open/close per side, EA stop) that can be bolted onto any EA in the catalog
novelty_note: tooling/admin video demonstrating LINE push-notification integration, not a trading mechanism

title: Trend-quality breakout entry (10-bar swing >=1000pips) with capped 2x martingale and doubling grid
indicators: New_Top_inTrend / New_Bottom_inTrend trend-quality blocks (10-bar swing-range check)
entry_long: New_Top_inTrend confirms uptrend quality (10-bar low-to-high swing range >=1000pips, quality param=8) -> buy fix 0.01L, no SL/TP
entry_short: New_Bottom_inTrend confirms downtrend quality (same params) -> sell fix 0.01L, no SL/TP
exit: close basket both sides when unrealized profit > $10
escalation_cap: Max_Order = 5 (closes/cuts the basket once open order count on either side reaches 5); lot doubles x2 and recovery grid distance also doubles (100->200->400 pips) per step
buildon_idea: already capped at 5 orders; run a flat-lot test to isolate the trend-quality entry's own edge from the martingale; author notes it performs far better in clean trending regimes (2021-2023) than in choppy 2019-2020, so a regime filter could replace or supplement the martingale layer
novelty_note: the trend-quality pre-filter (minimum N-bar swing range before entry) is a reusable regime filter distinct from plain candlestick patterns; doubling both lot size AND grid spacing per recovery step is a specific variant worth noting
